raw.query: SELECT v.run_id, v.p99_ms AS encoder_p99_ms, s.handoff_p99_ms, s.handoff_gbps FROM v_pool_latency v JOIN encoder_run_summary s USING (run_id) WHERE v.is_current = true AND v.run_id IN ('aggregate44:fc_p90_L30', 'aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_ds4')
raw.observed: For aggregate44:fc_p90_L30 (25 Gbps): handoff_p99_ms = 272.001, encoder_p99_ms = 588.37; For aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_ds4 (6.25 Gbps / 4x payload): handoff_p99_ms = 1087.406, encoder_p99_ms = 1403.774
raw.claimed: raises p99 handoff from 272 to 1,087 ms (encoder-delay p99 1,404 ms --- an SLA violation from transfer alone)
raw.evidence: Under 4x payload simulation (6.25 Gbps), handoff p99 rises from 272.001 to 1087.406 ms and encoder delay p99 reaches 1403.774 ms, violating the 1000 ms SLA.
